text: This solution, Structural Integrity Assessment and Retrofit Design of the Sandiganbayan Centennial Building addresses natural catastrophe through public private partnerships in Philippines between Sandiganbayan, Supreme Court of the Philippines, Government procurement bodies, University of the Philippines Building Research Service (UP BRS), University of the Philippines College of Engineering, and National Engineering Center. The program was implemented in 2023 and focuses on collaboration and regulation.
